description: The HarvestStat Africa team publishes harmonized subnational crop production statistics and matching administrative boundaries through Dryad under CC0. The article reports 574,204 records across 33 sub-Saharan African countries, 94 crops and years primarily from 1980 to 2022. The CSV identifies crop, season, production quantity, harvested area, yield and administrative units. These series can anchor food-supply or agricultural transport simulations that need production at a finer scale than national totals. A caveat is that original statistics came from changing administrative geographies and reporting systems; harmonization does not remove all missingness or measurement bias. The linked boundaries should be used with the matching version of the table. Preparation code has a separate GitHub repository. I read the own Dryad and DOI metadata plus article Data Records without downloading files, checking country series or modelling crop flows. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
